narrative: Material PL1__M84A42A1 exhibits smooth demand pattern with mean daily demand of 1862 units and coefficient of variation 0.54. Lead time averages 0.98 days but shows highly_variable behavior (CV=0.93), with lead time variability being the dominant factor (74.6%) in safety stock requirements. The optimized policy recommends safety stock of 3249 units (vs SAP: 0), reorder point of 5075 units, and order quantity of 11615 units (vs SAP: 2174). This optimization achieves a 95% service level while reducing total annual costs by $5952.74 (53.7%), primarily through better balancing of ordering and holding costs. The recommended safety lead time of 1.74 days is lower than SAP's 3.0 days, reflecting the actual risk profile.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Given smooth demand regime (CV=0.54) and highly_variable lead time, EOQ-based continuous review is appropriate. MOQ constraint applied (EOQ >> MOQ so MOQ is non-binding).
research_insights.boundary_risk: Lead time variability is high (CV=0.93), contributing 74.6% to safety stock variance. Any further supplier disruptions will erode service level. Supplier lead-time reduction is the highest-leverage improvement lever.
